description: This file defines classes and methods for serializing and deserializing silo registration data for Orleans clusters using Consul as a backend. It includes data structures for representing silo registration info and suspecting silos, as well as utility methods for converting between these structures and Consul KV pairs, facilitating cluster membership management.

classes.name: ConsulSiloRegistration
classes.description: Represents a silo's registration info stored in Consul, including metadata and status.

classes.name: SuspectingSilo
classes.description: Represents a silo suspected by another, with an ID and timestamp.

classes.name: ConsulSiloRegistrationAssembler
classes.description: Provides static methods for converting between Consul KV pairs and silo registration data, including formatting keys and creating objects from KV pairs.

methods.name: FormatVersionKey
methods.description: Formats the key for the version of a deployment in Consul.

methods.name: FormatDeploymentKVPrefix
methods.description: Creates the prefix for deployment-related keys in Consul.

methods.name: FormatDeploymentSiloKey
methods.description: Formats the key for a specific silo's registration in Consul.

methods.name: FormatSiloIAmAliveKey
methods.description: Formats the key for the IAmAlive status of a silo.

methods.name: FromKVPairs
methods.description: Creates a ConsulSiloRegistration object from KV pairs retrieved from Consul.

methods.name: FromMembershipEntry
methods.description: Converts a MembershipEntry and etag into a ConsulSiloRegistration object.

methods.name: ToKVPair
methods.description: Serializes a ConsulSiloRegistration into a KVPair for storage in Consul.

methods.name: ToIAmAliveKVPair
methods.description: Creates a KVPair representing the IAmAlive timestamp for a silo.

methods.name: ToMembershipEntry
methods.description: Converts a ConsulSiloRegistration into a MembershipEntry and associated etag.
